authoritative_source: canonical event/state/effect spine; existing production routes remain authoritative until explicit cutover gates pass

stages.name: SEMANTIC_MAPPING
actions: map current records to Clay IDs, typed relation instances, valid/transaction time, exact anchors
stages.gate: no unresolved identity/role/time collision for tested subset

stages.name: SHADOW_GRAPH
actions: build immutable semantic epoch + delta overlay from canonical inputs
stages.rollback: delete candidate epoch; prior paths unchanged

stages.name: PARITY_AND_REPLAY
actions: rebuild candidate from canonical event spine
compare exact anchors and relation state
stages.gate: no unexplained parity loss in scoped target corpus

stages.name: SHADOW_ROUTER
actions: compute BYPASS/SUPPLEMENT/ESCALATE/QUARANTINE decisions without affecting model-visible context
compare explicit-only, always-blend, shuffled and adaptive arms
stages.gate: route-specific gain without unacceptable false association/tail latency

stages.name: SHADOW_SALIENCE_UTILITY
actions: apply learned salience only to shadow field
run item/path vs assembly scalar credit comparisons
stages.gate: no truth/status/authority writes from utility; rare-topic/attractor metrics within preregistered bounds

stages.name: ADVERSARIAL_ATTRACTOR_POISON_TEST
stages.gate: bounded concentration, low false-attractor rate, robust rare-topic performance
stages.rollback: freeze learning + restore prior activation params

stages.name: DUAL_READ
actions: serve existing retrieval and CASAR Assembly in parallel
compare candidate identity, exact anchors, collection semantics and latency

stages.name: MODEL_VISIBLE_CANARY
actions: small target-Qwen fraction receives CASAR Assembly
stages.gate: truthful field provides reproducible utility and controls do not
stages.rollback: reader returns to existing context path

stages.name: DUAL_WRITE_WHERE_SAFE
actions: derived graph updates through durable derivation log/outbox
stages.rollback: stop consumer and rebuild from event spine

stages.name: CONTROLLED_CUTOVER
actions: retain explicit fallback and exact-anchor validation
stages.gate: live correctness/latency/recovery/security gates passed per route
stages.rollback: route class back to prior path

stages.name: ROLLBACK_WINDOW
actions: keep prior graph/index/query path and historical epoch readable
monitor regressions, drift, poisoning and device cost

stages.name: DEPRECATE_OR_KEEP_ISOLATED
actions: remove only redundant derived stores proven safe to retire

hard_isolation: raw source archive as immutable evidence where required
promotion_boundary: No migration stage authorizes canonical scientific promotion or destructive store consolidation by itself.
